purpose: DT single-kernel FP8 forward: source preparation concurrent with mini notify, FP8 dispatch/compute and BF16 return/combine.
scope: Explicit decode_only=True, training=False; single node. BF16 remains the default path.
api: y = runtime.inference_fp8(layer, x_or_rowwise_fp8_tensor, routes, gates, weights)
capture: Warm each layer/token bucket before outer capture. Keep input/data/scale/routes/gates addresses stable. Mutate contents in place. Discard outer graphs and invalidate_inference_layer before replacing weights or addresses.
reproduce_from_repository_root: BUILD_MODELS=qwen35b BENCH_PROFILE=1 BENCH_SIZES='1 64 512' BENCH_REPEATS=5 RUN_SUFFIX=-profile /opt/.venv/bin/python benchmarks/experiments/dt_fp8/run.py dt bench
timing: EP8, three model dimensions, tokens/rank 1/16/32/64/128/256/512. Alternating variant order and slowest-rank graph-replay latency. Includes online source work; excludes weight preparation. Prequantized-input variant excludes prior quantization. Random routes are static during each timed graph. Profile runs are separate and excluded from the final performance comparison.

validation.limit: diff < 5e-3; same for every model, M, token count, FWD and BWD
validation.dprob: record diff, require finite values, no numerical error limit
validation.exact_checks: quantized layout, source format and graph/eager equivalence remain exact
validation.known_case_exception: Performance experiments may explicitly enable TEST_DT_ALLOW_KNOWN_ONE_TOKEN=1: only Qwen35B rank7 replay-1-0-0, diff in [.005,.0051] and FP8-reference diff<5e-5. Default tests remain strict; reports record actual waivers.

autotune.new_candidates: Fixed M64; search operand stages, boolean slice scheduling and CTA count only.
autotune.eligibility: All correctness tests and timed inputs must pass the common BF16 global diff policy. A failed default is excluded, not a reason to abort other candidates. Models with no passing candidate have no finalists. No production settings are changed automatically.
autotune.reuse: Only identical native binaries; rerun all correctness checks and timings.

profiling.method: EP8 rank2, one NCU pass only, no clock or cache control, check replay output exactly. 90-second process-group deadline. Failures are preserved in summary.json. Stall-counter group is opt-in because replay can hang on communicating kernels.
profiling.limitations: Profiling changes rank arrival and barrier waits. Counter kernel time and throughput cannot substitute for unprofiled performance or isolate a single phase.
profiling.latency_eligibility: Paired default/previous-winner diagnostic timings use the common diff metric, but do not replace the full mutation/tail correctness suite.

implementation.M64: two math warpgroups each own N128; WGMMA FP32 block accumulation every K128; independent operand-stage release
implementation.AB: row-swizzled BF16 scratch; existing FP8 quantize/dequantize boundary retained
implementation.defaults: Fixed M64 for every BF16/FP8 shape, 3 TMA stages, slice scheduling, resident-cluster CTA clamp
